name: TopPIC Indexed Batch Pipeline
description: Batch top-down proteomics over one shared protein database: msconvert -> topfd -> topindex (ONCE per Run) -> toppic per sample. Every toppic job consumes the topindex completion marker, so the database is indexed exactly once per Run. DISK BUDGET: <fasta>_idx ≈ 2 x FASTA (two database copies + shift blocks); plan ≈ 4 x FASTA per Run — check free space for large databases.
